# INTAKE
[color=#9E1F17][bold]-- DROP IS LIVE. COPIES ONLY. NO ORIGINALS. --[/bold][/color]
The oath says a Marshal lets no injustice go unchecked. This folder is for the ones who checked it, and then cashed it.
Marshal Watch keeps case files on officers of the Colonial Marshal Bureau in the Neroid Sector who took money from a company, lost what was in their own evidence lockers, or sold the shipping lanes to the people they were sworn to stop. We do not post rumours. A file goes up when we hold two sources who have never met and one thing that can be checked: a docking log, a payroll line, a serial number that should be in a locker and is not.
Most Marshals are honest, and most of them are tired. A colony gets three deputies and a drunk tank. A company gets whatever it pays for. When the star is the only help a colonist can count on, a bought star is worse than none.
## THE FOLDER - [netlink="Dossiers" link="marshalwatch.deep/dossiers"]: named officers, who paid them and what it bought. - [netlink="Evidence Locker" link="marshalwatch.deep/locker"]: seizures that went missing, and the smugglers who got them back.
## DROPPING A FILE - Use a terminal that is not yours. Office machines keep a log. The night crew's machines do not. - Copy, never carry. Deputies who walk out with an original end up in their own reports. - Leave your name off. We do not want it and we will not ask for it. - If a Marshal from these files works your colony, do not confront them. Write down dates, hulls and amounts.
## NOTICE Files are amended, never deleted. A Marshal named here may answer through the same drop as everyone else. Two have. One of them was telling the truth.
